title: 개인정보 단체소송규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:12:0:00012:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 12 (Participation in Joint Litigation)
(1) An organization falling under any subparagraph of Article 51 of the Act may, with the permission of the court under Article 55 (1) of the Act, participate as a joint litigant under Article 83 of the Civil Procedure Act in pending collective litigation concerning personal information between another organization and a personal information controller. In such cases, an application for participation in joint litigation and an application for permission to participate in joint litigation shall be deemed a complaint and an application for permission to conduct litigation under Article 54 (1) of the Act, respectively.
(2) In cases under paragraph (1), Articles 54 (2) 2 and 55 (1) 1 of the Act shall not apply.
